title: Soju – play Windows games from Steam, Battle.net, Epic, GOG, EA, Rockstar, Ubisoft and Xbox on Apple Silicon Macs
description: Soju is a free, open-source Mac app from Didim Labs that installs the official Windows launchers (Steam, Battle.net, Epic, GOG, EA app, Rockstar, Ubisoft Connect, Xbox PC) on M1–M4 Macs and puts all your games in one library.

jsonld.name: Install Soju on an Apple Silicon Mac

step.name: Download the app
step.text: Soju-1.13.0-macos-arm64.zip. Unzip it and move Soju to Applications. Signing notes.

step.name: Pick launchers
step.text: Open Soju, go to Platforms and choose the launchers you use. Battle.net, Epic and GOG also use Apple's Game Porting Toolkit; Soju downloads Apple's files and checks Apple's signature before installing them.

props.title: Soju
props.lead: A free Mac app for playing Windows games on Apple Silicon. It installs the real Steam, Battle.net, Epic, GOG GALAXY, EA app, Rockstar, Ubisoft Connect and Xbox PC launchers, keeps each in its own Wine setup, and lists every installed game in one library.
props.meta: macOS 14+, M1 or newer · open source (GPL-3.0)

image.alt: Soju 1.10 library with Diablo II: Resurrected, Don't Sell the Cat, Guilt Free, Hogwarts Legacy and other installed games

props.headline: Your Windows games, **on your Mac.**
props.eyebrow: Free and open source · Apple Silicon

items.title: Real launchers
items.text: Battle.net, Epic and GOG share a Wine engine built from [CodeWeavers' sources](https://www.codeweavers.com/crossover/source) with Apple's D3DMetal. EA, Rockstar and Ubisoft run on a copy of it with DXMT. Steam gets its own Wine 11 setup with DXMT for D3D11 games.

items.title: One library
items.text: Finds installed games across every launcher and imports the games you own on Steam and GOG.

items.title: Store search
items.text: Searches Steam, GOG and Microsoft Store listings with prices for your region.

items.title: Xbox PC
items.text: Experimental: imports owned and Game Pass games and downloads them through the [Xodus](https://github.com/xodus-gaming/xodus) backend.

props.text: Logins, purchases and game updates stay with each store. Soju doesn't bundle games or store clients, and it downloads Apple's Game Porting Toolkit files during setup.

props.title: Games we've run
props.intro: Tested on an M4 Pro Mac with macOS 26.5. Other games may or may not work: [check a game](mac/) or [report what you try](https://github.com/BCD1210/soju/issues/new?template=compatibility.yml).

items.title: Download the app
items.text: [Soju-1.13.0-macos-arm64.zip](https://github.com/BCD1210/soju/releases/download/v1.13.0/Soju-1.13.0-macos-arm64.zip). Unzip it and move Soju to Applications. [Signing notes](https://github.com/BCD1210/soju/blob/main/docs/DESKTOP.md).

items.title: Pick launchers
items.text: Open Soju, go to Platforms and choose the launchers you use. Battle.net, Epic and GOG also use [Apple's Game Porting Toolkit](https://developer.apple.com/games/game-porting-toolkit/); Soju downloads Apple's files and checks Apple's signature before installing them.

items.title: Sign in and play
items.text: Sign in inside each launcher as usual. Installed games show up in the library.

props.text: Prefer the terminal? Run the installer, or use Homebrew. You'll need Rosetta 2, the Xcode Command Line Tools and Homebrew.

props.code:
curl -fsSL https://didimlabs.com/install.sh | bash

# or
brew install BCD1210/soju/soju
soju install

props.text: `soju doctor` checks the setup; `soju update` updates it.

items.q: Can I play Windows games on an M1, M2, M3 or M4 Mac with Soju?
items.a: Often, yes. Soju runs the Windows launchers through Wine with Apple's D3DMetal or DXMT. Diablo II: Resurrected, Hogwarts Legacy and Guilt Free have been played on an M4 Pro with macOS 26.5. Games with kernel anti-cheat do not run.
Yes. Soju is free and open source under GPL-3.0-or-later. You buy games from the stores as usual. Didim Labs also sells its own Mac games in Soju's store tab.

items.q: Which macOS version do I need?
items.a: The Soju app needs macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon. Steam games need macOS 26 or later, and Diablo II: Resurrected needs macOS 26.4 or later.

items.q: Is Soju a Whisky or CrossOver alternative?
items.a: It covers similar ground. Whisky is no longer developed and CrossOver is paid. Soju is free, focuses on the official store launchers, and builds its Wine engine from CodeWeavers' published sources.

items.q: Does Soju need my store passwords?
items.a: No. You sign in inside each official launcher. Library imports stay on your Mac and Soju has no account of its own.

items.q: A game won't start. What now?
items.a: Run `soju doctor` (or `soju doctor d2r`), check the guides, then [open an issue](https://github.com/BCD1210/soju/issues) with the game, your Mac, macOS version and what you see.
